definition.description: From a bilateral tall-kneeling position with both knees supported on a stable knee-tolerant surface, maintain hip extension and a controlled rib-pelvis position. Raise an intact slam-rated ball overhead, accelerate it straight down into the assigned floor target, then perform the declared dead-ball retrieval or controlled catch reset. This excludes standing, half-kneeling, rotational, scoop-start, partner-fed catch-to-slam, countermovement, or conditioning tasks.

environment.surface: dry, stable, non-slip, impact-suitable floor with knee-tolerant padding, a marked floor target, and a protected rebound or retrieval zone
environment.space: one athlete at a time; no people or fragile objects in the overhead, impact, rebound, or retrieval path
inspection: confirm intact slam-rated ball, impact-suitable floor, and knee padding
confirm overhead clearance, target, rebound behavior, and declared retrieval or catch route
confirm tall-kneeling base, grip, communication, and stop signal
environment.changeRule: Changing support position, knee surface, ball construction or mass, overhead range, target, release, rebound or catch rule, cadence, dose, or purpose requires revalidation.

selectionPrerequisites: comfortable supported bilateral kneeling, maintained hip extension, and controlled trunk position
can use the selected overhead range, grip, floor target, and declared retrieval or catch rule
current knee-surface, trunk, shoulder, grip, ballistic-ball, and session-fatigue budgets fit
understands target, reset, and stop signal
excludeOrEscalate: symptom, restriction, unsafe ball, knee surface, floor, clearance, target, rebound or retrieval, spacing, or communication conflict
pain, loss of grip, dizziness, neurologic, circulation, breathing, chest, balance, or communication concern
notEstablishedByEvidence: universal ball mass, range, recovery, readiness threshold, output, or clinical clearance

provenance.identityAuthority: Sources 1166 and 1320 plus ball-slam-foundations-v1 evidence packet. Their generic kneeling names are consolidated into this explicit tall-kneeling identity; exact candidate mechanics remain pending coach confirmation.

anatomy.laterality: bilateral tall-kneeling base and two-hand ball handling
anatomy.claimsBoundary: Task mechanics and likely loading sites only; no diagnosis, treatment, injury-prevention, isolated activation, or guaranteed performance claim.

athleteSupport.whyItMatters: Candidate tall-kneeling ballistic-ball exposure when this exact support position, ball, target, reset, and dose fit the workout.
athleteSupport.primaryCue: Kneel tall, keep hips and ribs organised, reach overhead, slam into the target, and reset safely.
secondaryCues: use padding that keeps both knees comfortable
do not sit back on the heels or lean through the low back
choose a ball that remains fast and controllable
do not chase an unsafe bounce
expectedSensations: brief trunk, shoulder, glute, and grip effort
high-intent downward acceleration followed by deliberate reset
unexpectedSensations: knee, hip, back, shoulder, elbow, wrist, or hand pain
loss of grip, loss of tall kneeling, uncontrolled throw vector, unsafe rebound, dizziness, or loss of balance
selfChecks: knees, padding, ball, target, and zone are clear
hips stay tall and the overhead path stays straight
assigned catch or retrieval is controlled

observationChecklist: exact tall-kneeling overhead-to-floor identity, not standing, half-kneeling, rotation, scoop start, partner feed, or conditioning
ball construction/mass, knee surface, target, clearance, spacing, rebound and retrieval route
hip extension, trunk, overhead path, grip, target accuracy, symptoms, and first quality loss

faultCorrections.sitting_back_or_hip_flexion_collapse: reduce ball mass, range, or repetitions; restore comfortable padding, tall hips, and full reset; stop if position will not return
faultCorrections.lumbar_extension_or_trunk_fold: reduce range or intensity, restore rib-pelvis organisation and target position, or stop
faultCorrections.target_drift_or_unsafe_rebound: reset target and retrieval rule; do not count or continue uncontrolled releases

doNotUseWhen: a standing, half-kneeling, rotational, scoop-start, partner-fed, countermovement, rebound-catch, or conditioning task is intended
ball, knee surface, floor, target, clearance, rebound or retrieval path, or communication is unsafe
the exact task conflicts with symptoms, restrictions, or current knee, trunk, shoulder, grip, or ballistic-ball fatigue budget

supportOperations.supportEscalation: Stop unresolved knee-surface, equipment, target, identity, symptom, or quality concerns and follow facility escalation policy.
supportOperations.changeImpactPolicy: Any change to support, ball, mass, range, path, target, release, rebound/catch, cadence, dose, or substitution reruns selection, logistics, duration, fatigue, substitutions, and validation.

snapshot.description: Trains rapid trunk flexion and overhead force expression while limiting lower-body compensation.

loadProfile.externalLoadMethod: impact-rated slam-ball mass selected for fast downward acceleration while preserving tall-kneeling hip and trunk control

contactExposureModel.per_set_range: record slams, ball mass and construction, knee surface, catch/retrievals, target accuracy, and other ballistic-ball work

deliveryProfiles.purpose: Candidate high-intent tall-kneeling overhead-to-floor power work when the exact ball, knee surface, target, reset, and recovery contract fit.

dosage.countRule: count only tall-kneeling overhead slams that hit the assigned target with declared catch/retrieval and a full reset

deliveryProfiles.qualityGate: Every counted rep retains comfortable bilateral knee support, tall hip position, organised trunk, overhead path, stable grip, marked floor target, safe retrieval rule, and no stop event.
stopRules: stop on knee, hip, back, shoulder, elbow, wrist, or hand pain; loss of grip; loss of tall kneeling; unsafe ball, floor, clearance, rebound, retrieval zone; loss of balance; or participant request
stop when speed, target accuracy, tall-hip position, trunk organisation, or safe retrieval cannot be restored
stop after two slow or mistargeted reps rather than converting this into conditioning
deliveryProfiles.coachInstructions: Inspect ball, knee surface, floor, target, clearance, and retrieval zone; declare mass, range, path, catch/retrieval, count, and rest; observe side and front views and stop at the first unrecoverable quality loss.
deliveryProfiles.athleteInstructions: Kneel tall on the assigned padding, set hips and ribs, raise the ball overhead, slam it into the marked target, then retrieve or catch it exactly as assigned before resetting.
deliveryProfiles.expectedAdaptation: Candidate task-specific tall-kneeling ballistic-ball exposure only; no universal power, sport, or injury outcome is guaranteed.

doseScaling.reduce: lighter appropriate ball, fewer slams, shorter overhead range, more padding, longer rest, dead-ball retrieval, or another reviewed task after revalidation
doseScaling.doNotAutoProgress: Do not add standing or half-kneeling support, countermovement, rotation, partner feed, mandatory rebound catch, or conditioning volume without revalidation.

supportPrompts.athlete: Kneel tall, hit the target, reset safely.
supportPrompts.coach: Confirm the tall-kneeling identity before counting a rep.
